import ast
import pathlib
import sqlite3

root = pathlib.Path('.')
def query(filename):
    tree = ast.parse((root / filename).read_text())
    return ast.literal_eval(tree.body[0].value)

readers = {name: query(name + '_reader.py') for name in ('old', 'new')}
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
db.executescript((root / '001_initial.sql').read_text())
db.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 'Ada'))
expected = [(1, 'Ada')]

def check(stage, expected_success):
    for name, sql in readers.items():
        try:
            rows = db.execute(sql).fetchall()
        except sqlite3.OperationalError as error:
            assert name not in expected_success, (stage, name, str(error))
            print(f'{stage}: {name} reader FAILS: {error}')
        else:
            assert name in expected_success, (stage, name, rows)
            assert rows == expected, (stage, name, rows)
            print(f'{stage}: {name} reader OK: {rows}')

check('Initial schema', {'old'})
db.executescript((root / '002_up.sql').read_text())
check('After up / rollback old-binary restart before down', {'new'})
db.executescript((root / '002_down.sql').read_text())
check('After down', {'old'})
assert db.execute('SELECT id, name FROM users').fetchall() == expected
print('PASS: compatibility matrix verified; up/down preserves seeded data.')
PY
